scope.description: Promoted integration leaves and immediate blockers only; this is not the complete Mecha Validate v1 format inventory.
scope.claim_policy: A consumer may make a production claim only for an explicit row whose production_ready is true. Missing rows and blocked or unsupported rows are not supported-format claims.

formats.claim: RAR5 stored and compressed entries covered by the committed corpus are decoded and checked against stored CRC32 or BLAKE2sp evidence; unsupported entries remain indeterminate.

closure.evidence: rarz invokes no external RAR decoder; Validate consumes its in-process implementation through the stable C archive-summary API.

mutation_evidence.scope: RAR5 stored non-empty payloads in the promoted rarz classifier
mutation_evidence.qualification: The promoted archive-summary gate classifies all 25 deterministic sniper mutations as damaged. Bolter and shotgun results have not yet been published under this exact aggregation contract.

formats.claim: Verified generations and methods use exact checksum evidence; RAR 1.4, header encryption, RAR4 split volumes, and unproven filters return indeterminate rather than valid.
blockers: header-encrypted archives lack a password-provider API
RAR4 split-volume and several VM-filter variants lack independent corpus gates

closure.evidence: The promoted rarz production path is a Peter-owned in-process implementation.

formats.claim: Current JPEG validation remains useful, but no first-party-only v1 claim is permitted until Validate consumes the promoted jpegz facade and removes libjpeg-turbo from its production closure.
blockers: promoted jpegz facade is not yet pinned in Validate's tiffz-owned dependency path
Validate production closure still includes libjpeg-turbo

closure.evidence: The mechanical Nix runtime-closure audit finds libjpeg-turbo.

formats.claim: The jp2z pure-Zig strict leaf and jpegz facade are promoted, but Validate has not aligned the exact facade path and still ships an OpenJPEG consumer path.
blockers: promoted jpegz facade fb72045459be7dc2c73337e321096ed3e1eedb0f is not yet aligned in Validate's tiffz-owned dependency path
Validate production closure still includes OpenJPEG

closure.evidence: jp2z's pure-Zig strict module is clean, but the current Validate consumer and Nix closure still link OpenJPEG.

mutation_evidence.qualification: These are sensitivity counts. A surviving entropy mutation may form a different valid codestream and is not automatically a false negative.

formats.claim: No complete RAW family has earned strict validation. DNG and one PEF private-Huffman slice have bounded partial evidence; rawz's parser-only closure is promoted upstream but not yet integrated into Validate.
blockers: Validate has not yet aligned tiffz c57166db87132742c7591c34161c5549133bd09a and rawz 2d030cf71075f5e126e07eaa2ad0c1377798b946 as one shared parser-module graph
sensor-corruption validators remain unsupported for most RAW families

closure.evidence: The promoted rawz closure is clean upstream. Validate's current dependency graph has not yet consumed it, so no production claim is allowed.

mutation_evidence.scope: PEF private-Huffman slice only, not PEF container dispatch or the RAW family
mutation_evidence.qualification: The independent sparse-Huffman oracle proves this bounded slice only. It must not be promoted into a family-wide RAW claim.

formats.claim: Validate consumes the promoted first-party libjxlz strict API and preserves valid, corrupt, unsupported, and indeterminate outcomes. The adapter remains non-claimable because one existing valid fixture is currently indeterminate.
blockers: ground_truth_examples/jxl/bicycles.jxl returns indeterminate with an unclassified decoder error

closure.evidence: Validate pins libjxlz at 5e8f9d68152ae8a70cb823061f4b6c733eb09166; the direct upstream libjxl build dependency is removed.

formats.claim: Current TIFF validation has substantial bounded evidence, but Validate has not aligned the promoted tiffz parser boundary and jpegz facade into its production graph.
blockers: promoted tiffz parser module is not yet aligned in Validate's production dependency graph
promoted jpegz facade and nested JPEG/JPEG2000 consumer path are not yet aligned in Validate

closure.evidence: The upstream parser-only boundary is promoted, but Validate still pins an older full tiffz graph with codec dependencies.
